question: Should SourceActor become the public inbound prompt/plugin SDK attribution contract as a structured object plus scalar mirrors after the Signal mention prerequisites?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but it creates a public prompt and SDK contract with identity/trust semantics that automation should not lock in without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve SourceActor contract
options.body: Land the proposed structured SourceActor plus scalar mirrors after the Signal prerequisite PRs, treating display names and peer IDs as explicitly untrusted channel metadata.

options.title: Route through existing channelContext
options.body: Defer prompt-visible SourceActor fields and keep channel-owned identity metadata on the existing hook/exec channelContext surface until a broader identity model is chosen.

options.title: Narrow to stable IDs first
options.body: Expose only the least ambiguous actor identifiers now and defer display-name or trusted-sender semantics to the open trusted identity issue.

recommendation.title: Approve SourceActor contract
recommendation.body: Land the proposed structured SourceActor plus scalar mirrors after the Signal prerequisite PRs, treating display names and peer IDs as explicitly untrusted channel metadata.
